text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 8 H7 THRU` "},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"IZBP"}],"comment":"Dimension D21 specifies an ⌀8 H7 fit on a part that is zinc plated (IZBP per the title block surface_treatment field), but no allowance is made for plating thickness. The added plating will reduce the bore below its H7 limit, preventing assembly with the mating pin or shaft; the designer should add a note to mask the holes before plating, ream after plating, or specify a pre-plate oversize.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'MASK ⌀8 H7 HOLES BEFORE PLATING' or provide a pre-plate machining allowance so the finished hole remains within H7 limits after IZBP coating."}]}
